ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There are multiple small graphs in the figure, among which graph a has light intensity on the horizontal axis and net photosynthetic rate on the vertical axis. In graph a, when the light intensity is 0, namely under dark conditions, the intercept of the straight line on the vertical axis is about -8. Reasoning: The question stem states that net photosynthetic rate = actual photosynthetic rate − respiration rate. In darkness there is no photosynthesis, so the actual photosynthetic rate is 0, and therefore net photosynthetic rate = − respiration rate. In the figure, the net photosynthetic rate in darkness is -8, so the respiration rate is 8 μmol.
